transcript: Speaker A: Yaar, ye goalkeeper kya kar raha hai? He ate the goal again. [Man, what is this goalkeeper doing? He ate the goal again.] Speaker B: Ek minute, he ate the goal? Bhai, goalkeeper hai, koi food blogger nahi hai jo ki goal ko kha jayega. Sahi English hoti hai, 'He conceded a goal'. [One minute, he ate the goal? Brother, he is a goalkeeper, not a food blogger who will eat the goal. Correct English is, 'He conceded a goal'.] Speaker A: Jaldi jaldi mein galat English nikal jaati hai. [In a hurry, incorrect English slips out.] Speaker B: Bhai, agar tu aisi English bolega na, toh sab tera mazaak banayenge. Tu ek kaam kar, abhi PW Talk app download kar le. [Brother, if you speak English like this, everyone will make fun of you. Do one thing, download the PW Talk app right now.] Speaker A: Hain? [What?] Speaker B: Hain nahi, haan. Ye phone pe ek app hai, theek hai? Isme tujhe mil raha hai Riva AI, jo ki hai tera personal English language coach. Isme kya hoga, jab tu usse personally baat karega, woh ye batayega ki tu kahan pe galti kar raha hai, lekin saath hi saath ye bhi batayega ki use sahi kaise karna hai. Yaani ki teri fluency aur vocabulary dono sahi ho jaani hai. [Not 'what', yes. This is an app on the phone, okay? In this, you get Riva AI, which is your personal English language coach. What will happen is, when you speak to it personally, it will tell you where you are making mistakes, but at the same time, it will also tell you how to correct them. Meaning, both your fluency and vocabulary will improve.] Speaker A: Bada mehenga hoga fir toh. [Must be very expensive then.] Speaker B: Arre kya mehenga bhai, World Cup sale chal rahi hai, sirf ₹7 mein! [Oh, what expensive brother, World Cup sale is going on, for just ₹7!] Speaker A: Sirf ₹7? [Just ₹7?] Speaker B: Haan, sirf ₹7 mein. [Yes, for just ₹7.] Speaker A: Sahi hai yaar. [That's great, man.] Speaker B: Aap football toh enjoy karo, lekin broken English bolke khud ka mazaak mat banao. Aaj hi download karein PW Talk app jahan aapko milega Riva AI, woh bhi sirf ₹7 mein. Toh link neeche diya hoga, aaj hi install karo. Dekh match... [You enjoy football, but don't make a fool of yourself by speaking broken English. Download the PW Talk app today where you will get Riva AI, that too for just ₹7. The link is given below, install it today. Look at the match...] Speaker C: English speaking seekhna hai toh PW Talk app abhi download karo. [If you want to learn English speaking, download the PW Talk app now.]

She introduces him to the PW Talk app's Riva AI coach, which corrects grammar and improves fluency. The ad highlights a special World Cup sale price of just ₹7 and urges viewers to download the app.
